text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"clearer paragraphing with topic sentences and a conclusion","quality":"organization","description":"The essay is more coherently structured, with ideas grouped into paragraphs that build toward a closing statement."},{"evidence":"“When i was younger...”, “In my last year of high school...”","quality":"development","description":"The essay supports its points with more developed personal examples rather than only brief assertions."},{"evidence":"“One of my best friend... he will tech me everything” vs. repeated short claims in B","quality":"sentence control","description":"The essay shows somewhat better control of sentence formation and keeps ideas more readable across longer stretches."},{"evidence":"“At the end of all of your hard work and time, it will be worth it.”","quality":"idea elaboration","description":"The essay more often explains how and why its claims are true instead of simply listing intentions or opinions."},{"evidence":"fewer awkward topic shifts within paragraphs","quality":"cohesion","description":"The essay connects its ideas more smoothly, so the reader can follow the progression of thought more easily."}]}
